attributes.name: Vigor
attributes.desc: Attribute governing HP. Also affects fire resistance and immunity.

attributes.name: Endurance
attributes.desc: Attribute governing stamina. Also affects robustness. This attribute also determines how heavy your equipment can be.

attributes.name: Strength
attributes.desc: Attribute required to wield heavy armaments. Also boosts attack power of strength-scaling armaments and affects your physical defense.

attributes.name: Dexterity
attributes.desc: Attribute required to wield advanced armaments. Also boosts attack power of dexterity-scaling armaments, reduces casting time of spells, softens fall damage, and makes it harder to be knocked off your horse.

attributes.name: Intelligence
attributes.desc: Attribute required to perform glintstone sorceries. Also boosts magic power of intelligence-scaling sorceries and improves magic resistance.

attributes.name: Faith
attributes.desc: Attribute required to perform sacred incantations. Also boosts magic power of faith scaling incantations.

attributes.name: Arcane
attributes.desc: Attribute governing discovery. Also affects holy defense, vitality, and certain sorceries and incantations.

statusEffects.name: Poison
statusEffects.effect: Lowers HP in steady increments for a period.

statusEffects.name: Scarlet Rot
statusEffects.effect: Greatly lowers HP in steady increments for a period.

statusEffects.name: Blood Loss
statusEffects.effect: Take damage equal to percentage of Max HP.

statusEffects.name: Frostbite
statusEffects.effect: Deals damage, lowers target's damage absorption and slows stamina recovery.

statusEffects.name: Madness
statusEffects.effect: Target loses FP and takes health damage.

statusEffects.name: Sleep/Eternal Sleep
statusEffects.effect: Puts the target to sleep; player is stunned and loses FP.
